privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body:
We respect your privacy. We collect only the information you provide when you enquire or book — such as your name, email, and travel preferences — and use it solely to plan and deliver your journey and to respond to you. We never sell your data. To request access to or deletion of your information, contact us any time.

This is a template policy — replace it with your agency's own privacy statement before going live.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.body:
By using this website and enquiring or booking with us, you agree to these terms. Enquiries are non-binding and no payment is required to request availability. Prices, availability, and inclusions are confirmed in your written proposal, and bookings, cancellations, and refunds follow the terms set out there.

This is a template — replace it with your agency's own terms before going live.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.body:
This site uses only the cookies necessary to remember your language preference and keep the site working. We do not use advertising or third-party tracking cookies. You can clear cookies at any time in your browser settings.

This is a template — replace it with your agency's own cookie policy before going live.
